    • setRequirement

      public MechanicalDatasheet setRequirement(String key, String value, String source)
      Stores a controlled project or vendor input against a listed requirement. Model estimates remain intact.

      this sheet

    • setHydrotestWeightBasis

      public MechanicalDatasheet setHydrotestWeightBasis(double assemblyDryMassKg, double filledVolumeM3, double densityKgM3, String source)
      Adds a hydrotest mass estimate for a defined assembly and filled volume.
      Parameters:
      assemblyDryMassKg - dry mass of the test assembly in kg
      filledVolumeM3 - volume included in the test fill in cubic metres
      densityKgM3 - test fluid density in kg/m3 at test conditions
      source - source defining the test assembly, volume and fluid basis
      Returns:
      this sheet
